dimensions.language_runtime: Current fresh foundation targets net10.0/C#14 with stable SDK10.0.401 pinned and observed .NET/ASP.NET10.0.12. Python3.12.x/Git2/Bash5 governance remains. Current constrained local build uses DOTNET_PROCESSOR_COUNT=1, DOTNET_CLI_USE_MSBUILD_SERVER=0 and MSBUILDDISABLENODEREUSE=1; shared compilation is disabled in the project. All projects and tests still execute.
dimensions.web_host: Current single Kestrel created with an empty configuration builder, fixed Production and one IPv4 loopback HTTP listener. Only GET/HEAD inert Razor root and foundation health routes. No business HTTP/MCP routes, custom worker, account or network-client registration. Data Protection key management/prewarm are removed and cryptographic operations explicitly reject.
dimensions.frontend: Current compiled local inert Razor shell with inline styles; no CDN, scripts, forms or business interactions. Bootstrap5/jQuery/Axios and visual/business interaction acceptance remain planned for later cards.
dimensions.database: Only newly created unique temporary empty directories can hold fresh synthetic SQLite test databases. The host does not create a database or choose a media path. No old/real media DB or backup may be probed, imported, migrated or opened.
dimensions.data_access: EFCore.Sqlite10.0.12 exists only in the new test project, with a synthetic test-only entity, Pooling=False and separate fresh databases. Foundation/Web have no direct external NuGet dependency or production schema. Dependency locks are current review inputs.
dimensions.background_jobs: No custom application worker, queue, integration, authentication or data service starts; only the framework web-host service runs. Durable HostedServices/product cancellation/retry/recovery remain planned.
dimensions.cache_messaging: No Redis, external broker or network cache. No account credential, token, service account or persistent security access is created.
dimensions.testing: New xUnit2.9.3/runner3.1.4/TestSDK17.14.1 cover distinct CLI, endpoint, dependency-registration, key-refusal and isolated SQLite/filesystem risks; new Python checks a real Linux host/socket and unchanged temporary runtime tree. Focused fixes get affected checks; final integration gets full applicable governance/foundation validation. Results are separately recorded, not inherited. GOV003 activation changes governance metadata only. Foundation acceptance remains bound to DEV001; future offline-domain work and its product tests are not yet authorized by activation.
dimensions.hosting_ci: Only the independent GitHub dot stage; exact SDK10, official locked NuGet restore, build, nonempty tests and real inert-host validation. Job-level DOTNET_GENERATE_ASPNET_CERTIFICATE=false is already published and inherited. Activation-only CI is not product acceptance. main remains read-only.
dimensions.deployment_network: No release/deploy, account setup, saved credentials, paid AI/TMDB or real media/data operation. Package restoration uses explicit official NuGet source. Application/test traffic is loopback; process socket sampling is not proof of every network moment. No development certificate generation or trust.
dimensions.ai_platform_shell: GOV003 actual author pmm-gov003-author / enable_pmm_offline_domain_stage; model unknown/null. Independent reviewer must differ. Linux x86_64/Bash only; Windows/macOS/PowerShell7 product acceptance remains NOT-RUN.
